ÇAHSPAR values rigorous scholarship and contributions that advance understanding of working life and social policy across societies. Recognition can make significant research more visible and encourage exchange between academic communities.

## An International Perspective on Research Recognition

We aim to highlight contributions to comparative inquiry, decent work, equality, inclusive social protection and innovation in research methods. We also seek to increase the international visibility of scholarship from Türkiye and bring relevant research from other regions into wider academic discussion.

Our approach values scientific quality, ethical practice, social relevance and fair recognition of collaborative contributions, including those of early-career researchers.
